lines.vo: Ever quit a new workout plan around week three?
That's not weakness. That's a myth.
Dre logs every session in his Fit and Strong Tracker, expecting it to feel automatic by day twenty one.
lines.cap: Dre logs every session in his Fit & Strong Tracker, expecting it to feel automatic by day 21.

lines.vo: In one well known study, it took people a median of about sixty six days for a new habit to feel automatic.
lines.cap: In one well known study, it took people a median of about 66 days for a new habit to feel automatic.

lines.vo: Some got there in eighteen days. Others took over two hundred.
lines.cap: Some got there in 18 days. Others took over 200.

lines.vo: And missing a single day didn't really set them back.
So week three isn't the finish line. It's the warm up.
Show up, check the box, keep going. That's how you stay on track.
